CAREERS AT HOPKINS MEDTECH
Bring your curiosity.
Build your experience.

Meaningful work. Thoughtful supervision. A closer look at the science and decisions behind medical innovation.

Explore opportunities
WHO WE ARE
Real questions.
Room to learn.

Hopkins MedTech Compliance is an independent contract research organization (CRO) for medical devices and in vitro diagnostics (IVD). Operated by Hopkins MedTech Group LLC, a New Jersey limited liability company, we plan and run clinical performance studies and prepare the regulatory submissions that follow, for the United States (FDA) and the European Union.

About us
THE WORK
Four connected areas.
New possibilities.

Our teams cover four areas.

Clinical operations

Study documents, site coordination, enrollment and visit tracking.

Regulatory affairs

Submission pathways, requirements and the evidence behind FDA and EU filings.

Clinical data and biostatistics

Data review and performance measures such as sensitivity, specificity and agreement.

Quality and compliance

Procedures, audit evidence and document control.

We also run an early-stage research initiative in AI and digital health, including facial and skin image analysis.

HOW WE WORK
Learn with people
who guide the work.

Each person works with a named project lead, meets on a set weekly cadence, and receives written feedback on every deliverable. Work is evaluated on accuracy and traceability of sources, documentation quality, responsiveness to feedback, and judgment about what to escalate.

Everyone works only with data and documents they are authorized to access. Confidential and patient-related information is never uploaded to public or unapproved AI tools, and all AI-assisted work is verified before it enters a deliverable.

TERMS AND RECOGNITION
Clear expectations.
Recognized contributions.
Format
On-site and remote arrangements are available, depending on the role.
Agreement
Each internship is covered by a written agreement with Hopkins MedTech Group LLC.
Certificate
Interns who complete the program receive a certificate of completion on company letterhead.
Reference
A letter of recommendation is available on completion.

APPLICATION INFORMATION
Your next step starts
with your education partner.
01 / REFERRAL
Speak with your partner

Candidates are referred through our education partners. Ask your partner about current opportunities and the referral process.

02 / INTRODUCE YOURSELF
A CV and a short note

Name the track you want, one project from the position description you would like to work on, and why.

03 / MEET YOUR PROJECT LEAD
A conversation about the work

First-round interviews are with the project lead who would supervise your work, not with a screening panel.

The AI and digital health initiative is early-stage research, not a cleared, approved or clinically validated product. Interns do not provide medical advice, make regulatory determinations, or represent the company to health authorities, clients or study sites.
